controls.class_prior: Literal TRAIN class prior, orientation-asymmetric diagnostic control

selection.tie_break: pure_elo first, then declared candidate order on exact ties

assumptions.evaluation: Retrospective actual-lineup-conditional series evaluation; not proof of actionable prematch lineup availability.
assumptions.rating_replay: Sequential source-calendar-day replay: earlier evaluation days may update ratings; same-day and future outcomes must not influence a day's features.
assumptions.classifier_fit: TRAIN only; no TRAIN+VALIDATION refit or test-label fitting.
assumptions.selection: Frozen 16-recipe ladder selected solely by VALIDATION log loss; exact ties favor pure_elo, then declared candidate order. No TEST selection or refit.
assumptions.feature_provenance: Caller supplies match-specific identity evidence and day-frozen historical features; numeric validation alone cannot prove original release clocks or pre-event availability.
assumptions.unit: One score-compatible played series; map-derived lineups require complete unchanged 5v5, while match-page captures remain conditional lineup evidence. No duplicated map labels or forfeits.
assumptions.side_symmetry: Classifier and calibrated forecasts are projected as 0.5 + 0.5 * (raw(X) - raw(mirror(X))); compact zero-intercept strength models and fixed probability blends also complement on reversal.
assumptions.orientation_controls: The literal TRAIN class prior is an orientation-asymmetric diagnostic control, not a deployable side-symmetric forecast; fixed 0.5 is an orientation-neutral control.
assumptions.rating_forecasters: Fixed-parameter channels consume preceding-day outcomes through the separately persisted rating state; raw channel recipes have no fitted classifier.
assumptions.development_diagnostics: Three expanding-origin folds entirely inside TRAIN days; initial half-day prefix followed by three consecutive blocks. Single-class prefixes are skipped without borrowing future labels.
